sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Awareness and Training Policy defines the requirements for ensuring that personnel operating {system_name} at {org_name} are aware of security risks and trained in their responsibilities. This policy applies to all personnel within the system boundary described as {boundary} who handle Controlled Unclassified Information including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Security Risk Awareness

questions.prompt: How are managers, administrators, and users made aware of security risks and applicable policies?
How often is security awareness training conducted?

sections.body: Managers, system administrators, and users are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and the applicable policies, standards, and procedures through {awareness_method}. This awareness activity is performed on a schedule defined by {awareness_frequency}.

sections.heading: 3. Personnel Training for Security Duties

questions.prompt: What training is provided to ensure personnel can carry out their assigned security-related duties?
How is the completion of security-related training verified and documented?

sections.body: Personnel are trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties and responsibilities via {training_curriculum}. Verification of training completion is managed through {training_verification}.

sections.heading: 4. Insider Threat Training

questions.prompt: How is training provided on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threats?
What is the defined process for reporting potential insider threat indicators?

sections.body: Security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat is provided through {insider_threat_training}. Personnel are instructed to report indicators using the {reporting_mechanism}.
